title: Follow the Process
coreMove: Shrink an overwhelming goal into the next clean process step and do that step without bargaining with the whole mountain.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Action, so it must move from clear seeing into visible execution under constraint. No source sidecar exists for ch14; this plan is grounded in the frozen TOC title and part placement only, with no named anecdotes invented. For "Follow the Process", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Shrink an overwhelming goal into the next clean process step and do that step without bargaining with the whole mountain.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into motivational busyness instead of a precise way to act against resistance. For "Follow the Process", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.
